api_only_actions.rewrite_post_copy: Claude writes copy itself and saves it with socialytics_post_copy_save; the API keeps the app's own rewrite for scripts.

auth.bearer: Machine clients send a Socialytics API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>; the key's scopes and client reach apply.
auth.oauth: Claude connectors sign in as the person through the project's Supabase Auth (OAuth 2.1): everyone reaches the clients they see in Socialytics; Moburst staff also save and start work; admins also read costs.

scopes.run: the work tools (two-step: an estimate and a confirm_token first)

description: Socialytics, Moburst's organic social tool, as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Generated from supabase/functions/mcp/catalog.ts by `npm run api:gen`; do not edit by hand.
name: socialytics

tools.description: List the Socialytics clients you can see, newest first, with their brand, readiness (setup) and last report. Call this first to turn a client's name into its id: pass part of the name as q, for example q "Bader". Returns { data, next_cursor }; pass next_cursor back as cursor for more.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, for the next page.

tools.name: socialytics_clients_list
tools.title: List Socialytics clients

tools.description: One client with its Sprout Social profile names, competitor sets with their social handles, and report schedules. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.
tools.name: socialytics_client_get
tools.title: Get a Socialytics client

tools.description: Social reports, newest first: period, status, deck link, counts and metric changes. To find a client's report for a month, list with its client_id and pick the one whose period covers that month, then call socialytics_report_get. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, for the next page.

from.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: socialytics_reports_list
tools.title: List social reports

tools.description: One social report: its header (period, status, deck link, counts, metric changes) and the sections analysis, calendar (the content calendar), performance (Sprout Social) and trends. Every section comes by default; a report too large for one answer lists the rest in omitted_sections, to ask for with sections. Call socialytics_clients_list and socialytics_reports_list first to find the report id.
tools.name: socialytics_report_get
tools.title: Get a social report

tools.description: Competitive reports, newest first: period, status, deck link, totals and quality check. Then call socialytics_competitive_report_get. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, for the next page.

tools.name: socialytics_competitive_reports_list
tools.title: List competitive reports

tools.description: One competitive report: its header and the sections analysis (executive summary, scorecard, gaps, winner teardown, competitor breakdowns) and aggregates (per company). Every section comes by default; a report too large for one answer lists the rest in omitted_sections, to ask for with sections. Call socialytics_competitive_reports_list first to find the report id.
tools.name: socialytics_competitive_report_get
tools.title: Get a competitive report

tools.description: Sprout Social performance for a client over a window (default the last 30 days): totals, the previous window, changes, per profile and top posts. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.
tools.name: socialytics_client_analytics
tools.title: Get a client's Sprout Social performance

tools.description: The client's weekly trend themes for the weeks with any day between from and to (default the last 30 days), newest week first, each with what is happening, why it matters, the angle for the client and the posts it is built on. If omitted_themes is present, ask again with an earlier to date for the older themes. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.
tools.name: socialytics_trend_themes
tools.title: Get a client's weekly trend themes

tools.description: The posts on a client's content calendar from one day to another (by default the client's today to 28 days ahead, at most 92 days), by date: each post's key, date, time, platform, format, pillar, copy, hashtags, call to action, why it is planned, whether someone has worked on it, and updated_at. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.
tools.name: socialytics_calendar_posts
tools.title: Get a client's calendar posts

tools.description: A client's content strategy as the Strategy page shows it: when it was written, each section (goals, audience, positioning, each pillar, each platform, not now, what to avoid, measures) with its key, title and text, who edited it and when where a person did, whether that edit came from Claude, and its version; and each platform's state. For Moburst staff. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.
tools.name: socialytics_strategy_get
tools.title: Get a client's content strategy

tools.description: What a client told the team, as Socialytics keeps it: the team's standing notes; the points every post for the client follows now (things to avoid, things to do, what is coming up and facts, each with its date and platform); and the notes, newest first, each with its id, title, date, who added it, whether it came from Claude or Socialytics, and where its reading stands. With note_id, that note's text. For Moburst staff. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.

note_id.description: One note's id, for its text.

tools.name: socialytics_client_notes
tools.title: Get a client's notes

tools.description: Adds one note to a client's notes in Socialytics: client feedback, a meeting note or an instruction from the client, with the date it was said. Socialytics reads it into the points every post written for the client follows, as it does notes added in the app. The same text saved again adds nothing and answers who saved it and when. Text up to 20,000 characters. client_id and client_name must name the same client. For Moburst staff, on clients they can change in Socialytics.

client_id.description: The client id, from the project instruction or socialytics_clients_list.

client_name.description: The client's name as Socialytics has it, to confirm the id. Case does not matter.

date.description: The day it was said or written (yyyy-mm-dd), no later than tomorrow. Defaults to today.

text.description: The note's full text, up to 20,000 characters.

title.description: A title, such as the file's name. Defaults to the text's first line.

tools.name: socialytics_note_save
tools.title: Save a client note to Socialytics

tools.description: Saves new copy for one post on a client's content calendar, as the calendar's Save does: the copy, and its hashtags and call to action when given. The weekly revisions then keep the post as it is. based_on is the post's updated_at from socialytics_calendar_posts; if the post changed after that, nothing is saved and the current copy comes back. Copy equal to what is saved changes nothing. client_id and client_name must name the same client. For Moburst staff, on clients they can change in Socialytics.

based_on.description: The post's updated_at, as socialytics_calendar_posts gave it.

client_id.description: The client id, from the project instruction or socialytics_clients_list.

client_name.description: The client's name as Socialytics has it, to confirm the id. Case does not matter.

cta.description: The call to action. Leave out to keep the post's own.

hashtags.description: The post's hashtags, up to 30. Leave out to keep the post's own.

tools.name: socialytics_post_copy_save
tools.title: Save a calendar post's copy to Socialytics

tools.description: Saves a person's version of one section of a client's content strategy, as editing it on the Strategy page does; the strategy's rewrites keep it. section_key and based_on (the section's version) come from socialytics_strategy_get; if the section changed after that, nothing is saved and the current text comes back. Text equal to the section's changes nothing, and empty text is refused. client_id and client_name must name the same client. For Moburst staff, on clients they can change in Socialytics.

based_on.description: The section's version, as socialytics_strategy_get gave it.

client_id.description: The client id, from the project instruction or socialytics_clients_list.

client_name.description: The client's name as Socialytics has it, to confirm the id. Case does not matter.

text.description: The section's new text, up to 20,000 characters.

tools.name: socialytics_strategy_section_save
tools.title: Save a strategy section to Socialytics

tools.description: Starts attaching a finished deck file (.pptx or .pdf, up to 50 MB) to a client's social or competitive report: returns a deck id and a one-time upload command for the file, valid for two hours. The deck shows on the report once socialytics_report_deck_save is called with that deck id. client_id and client_name must name the same client. For Moburst staff, on clients they can change in Socialytics.

client_id.description: The client id, from the project instruction or socialytics_clients_list.

client_name.description: The client's name as Socialytics has it, to confirm the id. Case does not matter.

file_name.description: The deck file's name or path, ending in .pptx or .pdf.

report_id.description: The id of the client's social report (socialytics_reports_list) or competitive report (socialytics_competitive_reports_list).

tools.name: socialytics_report_deck_upload
tools.title: Start attaching a deck to a report

tools.description: Lists a finished deck on a client's social or competitive report, where anyone who can see the report, the client included, can open it. Give deck_id once its file was uploaded with the command from socialytics_report_deck_upload, or link for a Google Slides or Drive link (https). Saving the same deck again adds nothing. client_id and client_name must name the same client. For Moburst staff, on clients they can change in Socialytics.

client_id.description: The client id, from the project instruction or socialytics_clients_list.

client_name.description: The client's name as Socialytics has it, to confirm the id. Case does not matter.

link.description: A Google Slides or Drive link (https), instead of a deck id.

report_id.description: The id of the client's social report (socialytics_reports_list) or competitive report (socialytics_competitive_reports_list).

title.description: The deck's title, as people should see it on the report.

tools.name: socialytics_report_deck_save
tools.title: Attach a deck to a report

tools.description: Every read endpoint of the Socialytics API this connection may call, from the live route table: path, what it returns, its path parameters and its query parameters. Use it to find data the other tools do not cover, then call socialytics_api with the path.
tools.name: socialytics_api_schema
tools.title: List the Socialytics API's read endpoints

tools.description: Call any read endpoint socialytics_api_schema lists, with this connection's own reach: path like /v1/clients/<id>/setup, and query as an object of parameters. Answers what the REST API answers. Lists return { data, next_cursor }; pass next_cursor back as cursor for more.
tools.name: socialytics_api
tools.title: Call a Socialytics API read endpoint

tools.description: Start a client's monthly social report (kind social) or competitive report on its confirmed competitors (kind competitive) for a period, by default the last 30 days. A run already open or running for the client is answered instead of starting a second. Follow it with socialytics_reports_list or socialytics_competitive_reports_list; a report takes about an hour. It costs money, charged to the client: call it first without confirm_token to get what it will do, an estimate and a confirm_token, show those to the person, and call it again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only once they agree. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from the first call. Leave it out to get the estimate first; nothing starts without it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same value on a retry never starts the work twice.

start.description: First day (yyyy-mm-dd); send with end, or neither.

tools.name: socialytics_report_start
tools.title: Start a social or competitive report

tools.description: Draft one social post for a client from a topic, in the client's voice, pillars and competitive picture: platform, format, hook, concept, visual direction, copy, CTA and hashtags. Nothing is saved; add it to the calendar in Socialytics. It costs money, charged to the client: call it first without confirm_token to get what it will do, an estimate and a confirm_token, show those to the person, and call it again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only once they agree. Call socialytics_clients_list first to find the client id.

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from the first call. Leave it out to get the estimate first; nothing starts without it.

format.description: Image, Carousel, Video, Reel, or Story (Instagram and Facebook only). Default: chosen for the topic.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same value on a retry never starts the work twice.

platform.description: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X and so on.

tools.name: socialytics_post_draft
tools.title: Draft a post

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from the first call. Leave it out to get the estimate first; nothing starts without it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same value on a retry never starts the work twice.

tools.name: socialytics_post_design_start
tools.title: Start a calendar post's designs

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from the first call. Leave it out to get the estimate first; nothing starts without it.

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from the first call. Leave it out to get the estimate first; nothing starts without it.

tools.title: Plan a calendar week

tools.description: What Socialytics' paid AI and data services cost over a period, in USD: the total and rows grouped by provider and client by default (or by day, feature, resource and so on). Default: the last 30 days.

from.description: Start, inclusive (yyyy-mm-dd). Default: 30 days before to.

group_by.description: Comma list of day, week, month, client, provider, resource, feature, bucket, env. Default provider,client.
